verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י רָעָב֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ מִלְּבַד֙ הָרָעָ֣ב הָרִאשׁ֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה אַבְרָהָ֑ם בִּימֵ֣י יִצְחָ֛ק וַיֵּ֧לֶךְ אֶל־ אֲבִימֶּ֥לֶךְ מֶֽלֶךְ־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים גְּרָֽרָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî rā·‘āḇ bā·’ā·reṣ mil·lə·ḇaḏ hā·rā·‘āḇ hā·ri·šō·wn ’ă·šer hā·yāh ’aḇ·rā·hām bî·mê yiṣ·ḥāq way·yê·leḵ ’el- ʾă·ḇīm·mɛ·lɛḵ me·leḵ- pə·liš·tîm gə·rā·rāh
verses.literal: Now there was another famine in the land subsequent to the [one] . . . that had occurred in Abraham’s time And Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines at Gerar

verses.original: יְהוָ֔ה וַיֵּרָ֤א אֵלָיו֙ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אַל־ תֵּרֵ֣ד מִצְרָ֑יְמָה שְׁכֹ֣ן בָּאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֹמַ֥ר אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yê·rā ’ê·lāw way·yō·mer ’al- tê·rêḏ miṣ·rā·yə·māh šə·ḵōn bā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer ’ō·mar ’ê·le·ḵā
verses.literal: The LORD appeared to [Isaac] and said Do not go down to Egypt Settle in the land where I tell you . . .

verses.original: גּ֚וּר הַזֹּ֔את בָּאָ֣רֶץ וְאֶֽהְיֶ֥ה עִמְּךָ֖ וַאֲבָרְכֶ֑ךָּ כִּֽי־ אֶתֵּן֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָאֵ֔ל הָֽאֲרָצֹ֣ת לְךָ֣ וּֽלְזַרְעֲךָ֗ וַהֲקִֽמֹתִי֙ אֶת־ הַשְּׁבֻעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖עְתִּי אָבִֽיךָ׃ לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם
verses.transliteration: gūr haz·zōṯ bā·’ā·reṣ wə·’eh·yeh ‘im·mə·ḵā wa·’ă·ḇā·rə·ḵe·kā kî- ’et·tên ’eṯ- kāl- hā·’êl hā·’ă·rā·ṣōṯ lə·ḵā ū·lə·zar·‘ă·ḵā wa·hă·qi·mō·ṯî ’eṯ- haš·šə·ḇu·‘āh ’ă·šer niš·ba‘·tî ’ā·ḇî·ḵā lə·’aḇ·rā·hām
verses.literal: Stay in this land {as a foreigner} and I will be with you and bless you For I will give - all these lands to you and your offspring and I will confirm - the oath that I swore to your father Abraham

verses.original: זַרְעֲךָ֙ וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֤י אֶֽת־ כְּכוֹכְבֵ֣י הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְנָתַתִּ֣י לְזַרְעֲךָ֔ אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הָאֵ֑ל הָאֲרָצֹ֖ת בְזַרְעֲךָ֔ כֹּ֖ל גּוֹיֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃ וְהִתְבָּרֲכ֣וּ
verses.transliteration: zar·‘ă·ḵā wə·hir·bê·ṯî ’eṯ- kə·ḵō·wḵ·ḇê haš·šā·ma·yim wə·nā·ṯat·tî lə·zar·‘ă·ḵā ’êṯ kāl- hā·’êl hā·’ă·rā·ṣōṯ ḇə·zar·‘ă·ḵā kōl gō·w·yê hā·’ā·reṣ wə·hiṯ·bā·ră·ḵū
verses.literal: I will make your descendants as numerous - as the stars in the sky and I will give [them] - all these lands and through your offspring all nations of the earth will be blessed

verses.original: עֵ֕קֶב אֲשֶׁר־ אַבְרָהָ֖ם שָׁמַ֥ע בְּקֹלִ֑י וַיִּשְׁמֹר֙ מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֔י מִצְוֺתַ֖י חֻקּוֹתַ֥י וְתוֹרֹתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·qeḇ ’ă·šer- ’aḇ·rā·hām šā·ma‘ bə·qō·lî way·yiš·mōr miš·mar·tî miṣ·wō·ṯay ḥuq·qō·w·ṯay wə·ṯō·w·rō·ṯāy
verses.literal: because - Abraham listened to My voice and kept My charge My commandments My statutes and My laws

verses.original: יִצְחָ֖ק וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב בִּגְרָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: yiṣ·ḥāq way·yê·šeḇ biḡ·rār
verses.literal: So Isaac settled in Gerar

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַמָּקוֹם֙ וַֽיִּשְׁאֲל֞וּ לְאִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר הִ֑וא אֲחֹ֣תִי כִּ֤י יָרֵא֙ לֵאמֹ֣ר אִשְׁתִּ֔י פֶּן־ אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַמָּקוֹם֙ יַֽהַרְגֻ֜נִי עַל־ רִבְקָ֔ה כִּֽי־ הִֽיא׃ טוֹבַ֥ת מַרְאֶ֖ה
verses.transliteration: ’an·šê ham·mā·qō·wm way·yiš·’ă·lū lə·’iš·tōw way·yō·mer hî ’ă·ḥō·ṯî kî yā·rê lê·mōr ’iš·tî pen- ’an·šê ham·mā·qō·wm ya·har·ḡu·nî ‘al- riḇ·qāh kî- hî ṭō·w·ḇaṯ mar·’eh
verses.literal: But when the men of that place asked about his wife he said She is my sister For he was afraid to say [She is] my wife since he thought to himself The men of this place will kill me on account of Rebekah because she is so beautiful . . .

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כִּ֣י אָֽרְכוּ־ ל֥וֹ שָׁם֙ הַיָּמִ֔ים אֲבִימֶ֙לֶךְ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַיַּשְׁקֵ֗ף בְּעַ֖ד הַֽחַלּ֑וֹן וַיַּ֗רְא וְהִנֵּ֤ה יִצְחָק֙ מְצַחֵ֔ק אֵ֖ת אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃ רִבְקָ֥ה
verses.transliteration: way·hî kî ’ā·rə·ḵū- lōw šām hay·yā·mîm ’ă·ḇî·me·leḵ me·leḵ pə·liš·tîm way·yaš·qêp̄ bə·‘aḏ ha·ḥal·lō·wn way·yar wə·hin·nêh yiṣ·ḥāq mə·ṣa·ḥêq ’êṯ ’iš·tōw riḇ·qāh
verses.literal: - When . . . [Isaac] had been there a long time Abimelech king of the Philistines looked down from the window and was surprised to see . . . Isaac caressing . . . his wife Rebekah

verses.original: אֲבִימֶ֜לֶךְ וַיִּקְרָ֨א לְיִצְחָ֗ק וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הִ֔וא אַ֣ךְ הִנֵּ֤ה אִשְׁתְּךָ֙ וְאֵ֥יךְ אָמַ֖רְתָּ הִ֑וא אֲחֹ֣תִי יִצְחָ֔ק וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ כִּ֣י אָמַ֔רְתִּי פֶּן־ אָמ֖וּת עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḇî·me·leḵ way·yiq·rā lə·yiṣ·ḥāq way·yō·mer hî ’aḵ hin·nêh ’iš·tə·ḵā wə·’êḵ ’ā·mar·tā hî ’ă·ḥō·ṯî yiṣ·ḥāq way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw kî ’ā·mar·tî pen- ’ā·mūṯ ‘ā·le·hā
verses.literal: Abimelech sent for Isaac and said So she is really . . . your wife How could you say She is my sister Isaac replied . . . Because I thought I might die on account of her

verses.original: מַה־ זֹּ֖את עָשִׂ֣יתָ לָּ֑נוּ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ אַחַ֤ד הָעָם֙ אֶת־ כִּ֠מְעַט שָׁכַ֞ב אִשְׁתֶּ֔ךָ וְהֵבֵאתָ֥ אָשָֽׁם׃ עָלֵ֖ינוּ
verses.transliteration: mah- zōṯ ‘ā·śî·ṯā lā·nū way·yō·mer ’ă·ḇî·me·leḵ ’a·ḥaḏ hā·‘ām ’eṯ- kim·‘aṭ šā·ḵaḇ ’iš·te·ḵā wə·hê·ḇê·ṯā ’ā·šām ‘ā·lê·nū
verses.literal: What is this you have done to us asked Abimelech One of the people - could easily have slept with your wife and you would have brought guilt upon us

verses.original: אֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ אֶת־ וַיְצַ֣ו כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר הַנֹּגֵ֜עַ הַזֶּ֛ה בָּאִ֥ישׁ וּבְאִשְׁתּ֖וֹ מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḇî·me·leḵ ’eṯ- way·ṣaw kāl- hā·‘ām lê·mōr han·nō·ḡê·a‘ haz·zeh bā·’îš ū·ḇə·’iš·tōw mō·wṯ yū·māṯ
verses.literal: So Abimelech - warned all the people saying Whoever harms this man or his wife will surely be put to death . . .

verses.original: יִצְחָק֙ וַיִּזְרַ֤ע הַהִ֔וא בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַהִ֖וא בַּשָּׁנָ֥ה וַיִּמְצָ֛א מֵאָ֣ה שְׁעָרִ֑ים יְהוָֽה׃ וַֽיְבָרֲכֵ֖הוּ
verses.transliteration: yiṣ·ḥāq way·yiz·ra‘ ha·hi·w bā·’ā·reṣ ha·hi·w baš·šā·nāh way·yim·ṣā mê·’āh šə·‘ā·rîm Yah·weh way·ḇā·ră·ḵê·hū
verses.literal: Now Isaac sowed seed in the land and that very year he reaped a hundredfold . . . And the LORD blessed him

verses.original: הָאִ֑ישׁ וַיִּגְדַּ֖ל וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ הָלוֹךְ֙ עַ֥ד כִּֽי־ גָדַ֖ל מְאֹֽד׃ וְגָדֵ֔ל
verses.transliteration: hā·’îš way·yiḡ·dal way·yê·leḵ hā·lō·wḵ ‘aḏ kî- ḡā·ḏal mə·’ōḏ wə·ḡā·ḏêl
verses.literal: and [he] became richer and richer vvv . . . until . . . . . . he was exceedingly wealthy

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי־ ל֤וֹ מִקְנֵה־ צֹאן֙ וּמִקְנֵ֣ה בָקָ֔ר רַבָּ֑ה וַעֲבֻדָּ֖ה פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃ וַיְקַנְא֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: way·hî- lōw miq·nêh- ṣōn ū·miq·nêh ḇā·qār rab·bāh wa·‘ă·ḇud·dāh pə·liš·tîm way·qan·’ū ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: He owned so many flocks . . . and herds . . . and servants that the Philistines envied him -

verses.original: פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַיְמַלְא֖וּם עָפָֽר׃ סִתְּמ֣וּם וְכָל־ הַבְּאֵרֹ֗ת אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָבִ֔יו עַבְדֵ֣י חָֽפְרוּ֙ בִּימֵ֖י אָבִ֑יו אַבְרָהָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: pə·liš·tîm way·mal·’ūm ‘ā·p̄ār sit·tə·mūm wə·ḵāl hab·bə·’ê·rōṯ ’ă·šer ’ā·ḇîw ‘aḇ·ḏê ḥā·p̄ə·rū bî·mê ’ā·ḇîw ’aḇ·rā·hām
verses.literal: So the Philistines took dirt and stopped up all the wells that his father’s servants had dug in the days of his father Abraham

verses.original: אֲבִימֶ֖לֶךְ וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֶל־ יִצְחָ֑ק לֵ֚ךְ מֵֽעִמָּ֔נוּ כִּֽי־ מְאֹֽד׃ עָצַֽמְתָּ־ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḇî·me·leḵ way·yō·mer ’el- yiṣ·ḥāq lêḵ mê·‘im·mā·nū kî- mə·’ōḏ ‘ā·ṣam·tā- mim·men·nū
verses.literal: Then Abimelech said to Isaac Depart from us for you are much too powerful for us

verses.original: יִצְחָ֑ק וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ מִשָּׁ֖ם וַיִּ֥חַן בְּנַֽחַל־ גְּרָ֖ר וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: yiṣ·ḥāq way·yê·leḵ miš·šām way·yi·ḥan bə·na·ḥal- gə·rār way·yê·šeḇ šām
verses.literal: So Isaac left that place and encamped in the Valley of Gerar and settled there

verses.original: יִצְחָ֜ק וַיָּ֨שָׁב וַיַּחְפֹּ֣ר׀ אֶת־ בְּאֵרֹ֣ת הַמַּ֗יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר חָֽפְרוּ֙ בִּימֵי֙ אָבִ֔יו אַבְרָהָ֣ם פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַיְסַתְּמ֣וּם אַחֲרֵ֖י אַבְרָהָ֑ם מ֣וֹת וַיִּקְרָ֤א לָהֶן֙ שֵׁמ֔וֹת כַּשֵּׁמֹ֕ת אֲשֶׁר־ אָבִֽיו׃ קָרָ֥א לָהֶ֖ן
verses.transliteration: yiṣ·ḥāq way·yā·šāḇ way·yaḥ·pōr ’eṯ- bə·’ê·rōṯ ham·ma·yim ’ă·šer ḥā·p̄ə·rū bî·mê ’ā·ḇîw ’aḇ·rā·hām pə·liš·tîm way·sat·tə·mūm ’a·ḥă·rê ’aḇ·rā·hām mō·wṯ way·yiq·rā lā·hen šê·mō·wṯ kaš·šê·mōṯ ’ă·šer- ’ā·ḇîw qā·rā lā·hen
verses.literal: Isaac reopened . . . - the wells . . . that had been dug in the days of his father Abraham which the Philistines had stopped up after Abraham died And he gave [these wells] the same names . . . - his father had given them

verses.original: יִצְחָ֖ק עַבְדֵֽי־ וַיַּחְפְּר֥וּ בַּנָּ֑חַל וַיִּ֨מְצְאוּ־ בְּאֵ֖ר חַיִּֽים׃ מַ֥יִם שָׁ֔ם
verses.transliteration: yiṣ·ḥāq ‘aḇ·ḏê- way·yaḥ·pə·rū ban·nā·ḥal way·yim·ṣə·’ū- bə·’êr ḥay·yîm ma·yim šām
verses.literal: Then Isaac’s servants dug in the valley and found a well of fresh water there

verses.original: רֹעֵ֣י גְרָ֗ר וַיָּרִ֜יבוּ עִם־ יִצְחָ֛ק רֹעֵ֥י לֵאמֹ֖ר לָ֣נוּ הַמָּ֑יִם וַיִּקְרָ֤א שֵֽׁם־ הַבְּאֵר֙ עֵ֔שֶׂק כִּ֥י הִֽתְעַשְּׂק֖וּ עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: rō·‘ê ḡə·rār way·yā·rî·ḇū ‘im- yiṣ·ḥāq rō·‘ê lê·mōr lā·nū ham·mā·yim way·yiq·rā šêm- hab·bə·’êr ‘ê·śeq kî hiṯ·‘aś·śə·qū ‘im·mōw
verses.literal: But the herdsmen of Gerar quarreled with Isaac’s herdsmen and said The water is ours So he named . . . the well Esek because they contended with him

verses.original: וַֽיַּחְפְּרוּ֙ אַחֶ֔רֶת בְּאֵ֣ר וַיָּרִ֖יבוּ עָלֶ֑יהָ גַּם־ וַיִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמָ֖הּ שִׂטְנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḥ·pə·rū ’a·ḥe·reṯ bə·’êr way·yā·rî·ḇū ‘ā·le·hā gam- way·yiq·rā šə·māh śiṭ·nāh
verses.literal: Then they dug another well and quarreled over that one {also} so he named it Sitnah

verses.original: וַיַּעְתֵּ֣ק מִשָּׁ֗ם וַיַּחְפֹּר֙ בְּאֵ֣ר אַחֶ֔רֶת וְלֹ֥א רָב֖וּ עָלֶ֑יהָ וַיִּקְרָ֤א שְׁמָהּ֙ רְחֹב֔וֹת וַיֹּ֗אמֶר כִּֽי־ עַתָּ֞ה יְהוָ֛ה הִרְחִ֧יב לָ֖נוּ וּפָרִ֥ינוּ בָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya‘·têq miš·šām way·yaḥ·pōr bə·’êr ’a·ḥe·reṯ wə·lō rā·ḇū ‘ā·le·hā way·yiq·rā šə·māh rə·ḥō·ḇō·wṯ way·yō·mer kî- ‘at·tāh Yah·weh hir·ḥîḇ lā·nū ū·p̄ā·rî·nū ḇā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: He moved on from there and dug . . . another [well] and they did not quarrel over it He named it Rehoboth and said At last . . . the LORD has made room for us and we will be fruitful in the land

verses.original: מִשָּׁ֖ם בְּאֵ֥ר וַיַּ֥עַל שָֽׁבַע׃
verses.transliteration: miš·šām bə·’êr way·ya·‘al šā·ḇa‘
verses.literal: From there [Isaac] went up to Beersheba

verses.original: הַה֔וּא בַּלַּ֣יְלָה יְהוָה֙ וַיֵּרָ֨א אֵלָ֤יו וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אָנֹכִ֕י אֱלֹהֵ֖י אָבִ֑יךָ אַבְרָהָ֣ם אַל־ תִּירָא֙ כִּֽי־ אָנֹ֔כִי אִתְּךָ֣ וּבֵֽרַכְתִּ֙יךָ֙ וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֣י אֶֽת־ זַרְעֲךָ֔ בַּעֲב֖וּר עַבְדִּֽי׃ אַבְרָהָ֥ם
verses.transliteration: ha·hū bal·lay·lāh Yah·weh way·yê·rā ’ê·lāw way·yō·mer ’ā·nō·ḵî ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ā·ḇî·ḵā ’aḇ·rā·hām ’al- tî·rā kî- ’ā·nō·ḵî ’it·tə·ḵā ū·ḇê·raḵ·tî·ḵā wə·hir·bê·ṯî ’eṯ- zar·‘ă·ḵā ba·‘ă·ḇūr ‘aḇ·dî ’aḇ·rā·hām
verses.literal: and that night the LORD appeared to him and said I am the God of your father Abraham Do not be afraid for I am with you I will bless you and multiply - your descendants for the sake of My servant Abraham

verses.original: וַיִּ֧בֶן מִזְבֵּ֗חַ שָׁ֣ם וַיִּקְרָא֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה וַיֶּט־ אָהֳל֑וֹ שָׁ֖ם יִצְחָ֖ק עַבְדֵי־ וַיִּכְרוּ־ בְּאֵֽר׃ שָׁ֥ם
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen miz·bê·aḥ šām way·yiq·rā bə·šêm Yah·weh way·yeṭ- ’ā·ho·lōw šām yiṣ·ḥāq ‘aḇ·ḏê- way·yiḵ·rū- bə·’êr šām
verses.literal: So [Isaac] built an altar there and called on the name of the LORD and he pitched his tent there [His] servants also dug a well there

verses.original: וַאֲבִימֶ֕לֶךְ הָלַ֥ךְ אֵלָ֖יו מִגְּרָ֑ר וַאֲחֻזַּת֙ מֵֽרֵעֵ֔הוּ וּפִיכֹ֖ל שַׂר־ צְבָאֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḇî·me·leḵ hā·laḵ ’ê·lāw mig·gə·rār wa·’ă·ḥuz·zaṯ mê·rê·‘ê·hū ū·p̄î·ḵōl śar- ṣə·ḇā·’ōw
verses.literal: Later, Abimelech came to [Isaac] from Gerar with Ahuzzath his adviser and Phicol the commander of his army

verses.original: מַדּ֖וּעַ בָּאתֶ֣ם אֵלָ֑י יִצְחָ֔ק וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ וְאַתֶּם֙ שְׂנֵאתֶ֣ם אֹתִ֔י וַתְּשַׁלְּח֖וּנִי מֵאִתְּכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mad·dū·a‘ bā·ṯem ’ê·lāy yiṣ·ḥāq way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem wə·’at·tem śə·nê·ṯem ’ō·ṯî wat·tə·šal·lə·ḥū·nî mê·’it·tə·ḵem
verses.literal: Why have you come to me Isaac asked them You hated me and sent me away . . .

verses.original: רָא֣וֹ רָאִינוּ֮ כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֣ה׀ הָיָ֣ה עִמָּךְ֒ וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ וַנֹּ֗אמֶר תְּהִ֨י נָ֥א אָלָ֛ה בֵּינוֹתֵ֖ינוּ בֵּינֵ֣ינוּ וּבֵינֶ֑ךָ וְנִכְרְתָ֥ה בְרִ֖ית עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: rā·’ōw rā·’î·nū kî- Yah·weh hā·yāh ‘im·māḵ way·yō·mə·rū wan·nō·mer tə·hî nā ’ā·lāh bê·nō·w·ṯê·nū bê·nê·nū ū·ḇê·ne·ḵā wə·niḵ·rə·ṯāh ḇə·rîṯ ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: We can plainly see . . . that the LORD has been with you they replied We recommend that there should now be . . . an oath between us and you Let us make a covenant with you

verses.original: אִם־ תַּעֲשֵׂ֨ה רָעָ֗ה עִמָּ֜נוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א נְגַֽעֲנ֔וּךָ וְכַאֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשִׂ֤ינוּ רַק־ ט֔וֹב עִמְּךָ֙ וַנְּשַׁלֵּֽחֲךָ֖ בְּשָׁל֑וֹם עַתָּ֖ה אַתָּ֥ה בְּר֥וּךְ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ta·ʿă·śēh rā·‘āh ‘im·mā·nū ka·’ă·šer lō nə·ḡa·‘ă·nū·ḵā wə·ḵa·’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·nū raq- ṭō·wḇ ‘im·mə·ḵā wan·nə·šal·lê·ḥă·ḵā bə·šā·lō·wm ‘at·tāh ’at·tāh bə·rūḵ Yah·weh
verses.literal: that you will not harm us just as we have not harmed you but have done only good to you sending you on your way in peace And now you are blessed by the LORD

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ מִשְׁתֶּ֔ה לָהֶם֙ וַיֹּאכְל֖וּ וַיִּשְׁתּֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś miš·teh lā·hem way·yō·ḵə·lū way·yiš·tū
verses.literal: So [Isaac] prepared a feast for them and they ate and drank

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכִּ֣ימוּ בַבֹּ֔קֶר וַיִּשָּׁבְע֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ לְאָחִ֑יו יִצְחָ֔ק וַיְשַׁלְּחֵ֣ם וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ מֵאִתּ֖וֹ בְּשָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·kî·mū ḇab·bō·qer way·yiš·šā·ḇə·‘ū ’îš lə·’ā·ḥîw yiṣ·ḥāq way·šal·lə·ḥêm way·yê·lə·ḵū mê·’it·tōw bə·šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: And they got up early the next morning and swore an oath to each other Then Isaac sent them on their way and they left him . . . in peace

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ הַה֗וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם יִצְחָ֔ק עַבְדֵ֣י וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ וַיַּגִּ֣דוּ ל֔וֹ עַל־ אֹד֥וֹת הַבְּאֵ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָפָ֑רוּ מָצָ֥אנוּ מָֽיִם׃ וַיֹּ֥אמְרוּ ל֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: way·hî ha·hū bay·yō·wm yiṣ·ḥāq ‘aḇ·ḏê way·yā·ḇō·’ū way·yag·gi·ḏū lōw ‘al- ’ō·ḏō·wṯ hab·bə·’êr ’ă·šer ḥā·p̄ā·rū mā·ṣā·nū mā·yim way·yō·mə·rū lōw
verses.literal: - On that same day Isaac’s servants came and told him about . . . the well - they had dug We have found water they told him

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֹתָ֖הּ שִׁבְעָ֑ה עַל־ כֵּ֤ן עַ֖ד הַזֶּֽה׃ס הַיּ֥וֹם שֵׁם־ הָעִיר֙ בְּאֵ֣ר שֶׁ֔בַע
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ’ō·ṯāh šiḇ·‘āh ‘al- kên ‘aḏ haz·zeh hay·yō·wm šêm- hā·‘îr bə·’êr še·ḇa‘
verses.literal: So he called it Shibah and - to this day the name of the city vvv is Beersheba

verses.original: עֵשָׂו֙ וַיְהִ֤י אַרְבָּעִ֣ים בֶּן־ שָׁנָ֔ה וַיִּקַּ֤ח אִשָּׁה֙ אֶת־ יְהוּדִ֔ית בַּת־ בְּאֵרִ֖י הַֽחִתִּ֑י וְאֶת־ בָּ֣שְׂמַ֔ת בַּת־ אֵילֹ֖ן הַֽחִתִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·śāw way·hî ’ar·bā·‘îm ben- šā·nāh way·yiq·qaḥ ’iš·šāh ’eṯ- yə·hū·ḏîṯ baṯ- bə·’ê·rî ha·ḥit·tî wə·’eṯ- bā·śə·maṯ baṯ- ’ê·lōn ha·ḥit·tî
verses.literal: When Esau was forty years old . . . he took as his wives - Judith daughter of Beeri the Hittite - and Basemath daughter of Elon the Hittite

verses.original: וַתִּהְיֶ֖יןָ ר֑וּחַ מֹ֣רַת לְיִצְחָ֖ק וּלְרִבְקָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wat·tih·ye·nā rū·aḥ mō·raṯ lə·yiṣ·ḥāq ū·lə·riḇ·qāh
verses.literal: And they brought grief to Isaac and Rebekah
